# ScienceDaily

> ScienceDaily is a leading online science news source aggregating breaking research discoveries across medicine, health, physics, biology, and environmental science with expert analysis and peer-reviewed study coverage.

ScienceDaily provides daily updates on scientific breakthroughs from universities and research institutions worldwide. The site organizes content by topic areas including health, neuroscience, and technology, with RSS feeds available for personalized content delivery.

## Key Topics

- Medical Breakthroughs
- Cancer Research
- Cardiovascular Health
- Neuroscience
- Brain Health
- Clinical Trials
- AI and Health
- Mental Health
- Environmental Health
- PFAS
- Cognitive Science
- Heart Disease Prevention
- Health Research
- Drug Development
- Quantum Physics

## Latest Medical Breakthroughs

- [New pill cuts "bad" cholesterol by 60% in major trial](https://sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/03/260321012659.htm): Enlicitide pill reduces LDL cholesterol by 60% in clinical trial, offering new cardiovascular disease prevention option
- [New AI tool predicts cancer spread with surprising accuracy](https://sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/03/260321012709.htm): MangroveGS AI predicts cancer metastasis with 80% accuracy, advancing personalized cancer treatment planning
- [Scientists turn probiotic bacteria into tumor-hunting cancer killers](https://sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/03/260321004445.htm): Engineered probiotic bacteria target tumors as drug factories, opening new immunotherapy approaches
- [This virus therapy supercharges the immune system against brain cancer](https://sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/03/260319044708.htm): Modified virus therapy activates immunity against glioblastoma, showing promise for previously untreatable cancers
- [This common vaccine cuts heart risk nearly in half in new study](https://sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/03/260319044659.htm): Shingles vaccine reduces cardiac events by 46% in high-risk patients, revealing unexpected cardiovascular benefits
- [What happens after Ozempic shocked researchers](https://sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/03/260319044648.htm): Real-world study shows weight loss maintained after Ozempic discontinuation, providing insights into long-term metabolic effects

## Health, Neuroscience & Mental Health

- [Men are losing a key chromosome with age and it may be deadly](https://sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/03/260319044711.htm): Y chromosome loss in aging men linked to disease and mortality, revealing new aging mechanism
- [Huge study finds no evidence cannabis helps anxiety, depression, or PTSD](https://sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/03/260319044656.htm): Large review finds medicinal cannabis ineffective for anxiety and PTSD, challenging popular health assumptions
- [These "forever chemicals" could be weakening kids' bones for life](https://sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/03/260321004440.htm): PFAS exposure linked to lower bone density in adolescents, raising environmental health concerns
- [Closing your eyes to hear better might be a big mistake](https://sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/03/260320073819.htm): Study shows keeping eyes open improves hearing in noisy environments, demonstrating multisensory perception integration
- [Perception News](https://sciencedaily.com/news/mind_brain/perception): Topic page featuring perception research and sensory science news
- [Intelligence News](https://sciencedaily.com/news/mind_brain/intelligence): Topic page covering intelligence research and cognitive science
- [Social Psychology News](https://sciencedaily.com/news/mind_brain/social_psychology): Topic page featuring social psychology and behavioral research

## Physics, Technology & Quantum Science

- [Harvard engineers build chip that can twist and control light in real time](https://sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/03/260321012702.htm): Harvard photonic crystal chip manipulates light polarization in real time, advancing optical computing
- [Scientists just found a hidden 48-dimensional world in quantum light](https://sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/03/260321012705.htm): Quantum optics reveals 48-dimensional topological structures in light, expanding understanding of quantum phenomena

## Earth Science & Paleontology

- [Tectonic shift: Earth was already moving 3.5 billion years ago](https://sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/03/260321012636.htm): Magnetic analysis reveals plate tectonics active 3.5 billion years ago, rewriting early Earth history
- [This crocodile ran like a greyhound across prehistoric Britain 200 million years ago](https://sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/03/260321012715.htm): Triassic reptile Galahadosuchus jonesi fossil reveals fast predator, shedding light on ancient ecosystems
